programs.name: E8 Pro
programs.consistency_rule: None, but a $1,000 daily profit cap

programs.name: E8 Signature
programs.consistency_rule: None in the challenge; 35% in the performance stage

news_trading: Restricted: allowed on E8 Pro, E8 Signature and in the E8 One Challenge stage; E8 One Performance accounts may not open/close trades 5 minutes before to 5 minutes after high-impact news
ea_bots_allowed: Allowed on E8 One and E8 Pro and Signature Classic/Perpetuals, provided multiple users are not running the same trades/strategy; not allowed on Futures (Signature Futures, E8 Zero)
copy_trading: Restricted: copying between your own accounts allowed; cooperation with other traders prohibited; hedging across accounts prohibited
overnight_weekend_holding: Allowed on E8 One and E8 Pro (incl. weekend); E8 Signature positions are auto-closed at 23:00 server time
restricted_countries_note: Not offered in Cuba, Syria, Iran, Lebanon, Iraq, Yemen, North Korea, Russia, Ukraine, Belarus and ~30 others; longer list for futures (incl. China, Indonesia, Turkey, Vietnam, Nigeria, Philippines). MT5 not available to US citizens (US traders use TradeLocker/cTrader/Match-Trader via the US entity). https://help.e8markets.com/en/articles/5514278-accepted-countries

affiliate_program.commission: not published (claims '2x vs typical category rates'; rate card on request)
affiliate_program.notes: Applications reviewed in 3 business days; not all accepted; seats limited by region.
